ei.title: 2번: The Functions and Future of Music Sampling
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Music sampling involves taking part of an existing recording and using it in a new song. Musicians have been sampling for a long time, but the practice has become more common in recent years. Samples from older songs are often used to bring back old memories. By using samples that are familiar to older listeners, musicians create music that is popular with people of all ages. Musicians use samples not only to bridge generation gaps between listeners, but also to create new approaches to song production. They want to create unique sounds and come up with innovative ways of writing songs. Therefore, we can expect to see new and experimental ways of including samples in songs, and for sampling to become more and more popular in the future.

questions.passage: Music sampling involves taking part of an existing recording and using it in a new song. Musicians have been sampling for a long time, but the practice has become more (A)[common / rare] in recent years. Samples from older songs are often used to bring back old memories. By using samples that are (B)[familiar / strange] to older listeners, musicians create music that is popular with people of all ages. Musicians use samples not only to bridge generation gaps between listeners, but also to create new approaches to song production. They want to create (C)[ordinary / unique] sounds and come up with innovative ways of writing songs. Therefore, we can expect to see new and experimental ways of including samples in songs, and for sampling to become more and more popular in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) common=흔한 / rare=드문 (B) familiar=친숙한 / strange=낯선 (C) unique=독특한 / ordinary=평범한
det.analysis:
① common—familiar—unique: 샘플링이 더 흔해지고, 나이 든 청취자에게 친숙한 샘플로, 독특한 사운드를 만든다 ←정답
② rare: 최근 더 '드물게' 되었다? 본문은 more common(더 흔해짐)
③ strange/ordinary: 낯선 샘플/평범한 사운드는 문맥과 반대
④ rare/strange/ordinary: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 샘플링이 흔해지고(common), 친숙한(familiar) 샘플로 독특한(unique) 사운드를 만든다는 흐름

questions.passage: Music sampling involves taking part of an (A)[existing / new] recording and using it in a new song. Musicians have been sampling for a long time, but the practice has become more common in recent years. Samples from older songs are often used to bring back old memories. By using samples that are (B)[familiar / strange] to older listeners, musicians create music that is popular with people of all ages. Musicians use samples not only to bridge generation gaps between listeners, but also to create new approaches to song production. They want to create unique sounds and come up with innovative ways of writing songs. Therefore, we can expect to see new and (C)[conventional / experimental] ways of including samples in songs, and for sampling to become more and more popular in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) existing=기존의 / new=새로운 (B) familiar=친숙한 / strange=낯선 (C) experimental=실험적인 / conventional=관습적인
det.analysis:
① new: 기존(existing) 녹음의 일부를 가져오는 것 — new는 문맥과 반대
② existing—strange—conventional: (B)(C) 친숙한 샘플, 실험적 방식과 반대
③ existing—familiar—experimental: 기존 녹음 활용 + 친숙한 샘플 + 실험적 방식 ←정답
④ new—strange—conventional: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 기존(existing) 녹음을 친숙한(familiar) 샘플로 활용해 실험적(experimental) 방식을 만든다는 흐름

questions.passage: Music sampling involves taking part of an existing recording and using it in a new song. Musicians have been sampling for a long time, but the practice has become more common in recent years. Samples from older songs are often used to bring back old memories. By using samples that are familiar to older listeners, musicians create music that is popular with people of all ages. Musicians use samples not only to (A)[widen / bridge] generation gaps between listeners, but also to create new approaches to song production. They want to create unique sounds and come up with innovative ways of writing songs. Therefore, we can expect to see new and (B)[experimental / conventional] ways of including samples in songs, and for sampling to become more and more popular in the (C)[future / past].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) bridge=(간극을) 잇다 / widen=넓히다 (B) experimental=실험적인 / conventional=관습적인 (C) future=미래 / past=과거
det.analysis:
① widen: 세대 간극을 '넓힌다'? 본문은 bridge(잇다)로 간극을 줄임
② bridge—experimental—future: 세대 간극을 잇고, 실험적 방식으로, 미래에 샘플링이 더 인기 있어진다 ←정답
③ conventional/past: 관습적 방식/과거는 문맥과 반대
④ widen/conventional/past: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 세대 간극을 잇고(bridge) 실험적(experimental) 방식으로 미래(future)에 샘플링이 확산되는 흐름

det.tip: are often _____ → 수동태(be + p.p.) → used

questions.passage: By __________ (use) samples that are familiar to older listeners, musicians create music that is popular with people of all ages.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: use(동사: 사용하다) → using (동명사, 전치사 By 뒤)
det.analysis: use를 동명사 using으로 변환. 전치사 By 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 'By using'(~을 사용함으로써)이 됨
det.tip: 전치사 By 뒤 → 동명사(-ing) → using

questions.passage: Music sampling involves taking part of an existing recording and using it in a new song. Musicians have been sampling for a long time, but the practice has become more common in recent years. Samples from older songs are often used to bring back old memories. By using samples that are familiar to older listeners, musicians create music that is popular with people of all ages. Musicians use samples not only to bridge __________ between listeners, but also to create new approaches to song production. They want to create unique sounds and come up with innovative ways of writing songs. Therefore, we can expect to see new and experimental ways of including samples in songs, and for sampling to become more and more popular in the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: song production=곡 제작 / old memories=옛 추억 / generation gaps=세대 간극 / unique sounds=독특한 사운드
det.analysis:
① song production: 청취자 사이의 곡 제작을 잇는다? between listeners와 어울리지 않음
② old memories: 청취자 사이의 옛 추억을 잇는다? 어색함
③ generation gaps: 청취자 사이의 세대 간극을 잇는다 ←정답
④ unique sounds: 청취자 사이의 독특한 사운드를 잇는다? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: bridge __________ between listeners = 청취자 사이 세대 간극(generation gaps)
